expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Provides types.ts, useDocumentSelection.ts, api/documents.ts, useBulkDocumentActions.ts, ConfirmBulkDeleteDialog.tsx, BulkActionsBar.tsx, and DocumentsTable.tsx with full implementations covering selection, mutations, paging, and bulk operations.

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: All components written with full JSX, event handlers, styling, and state management; not prescriptive guidance.

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Soft-deletes to Trash, provides undoToken, offers 10-second undo toast with action button via useBulkDocumentActions.ts: 'if (result.undoToken) { toast.success(label, { duration: 10_000, action: { label: 'Undo', onClick: () => undo.mutate(token) } })'

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: BulkActionsBar displays count in live region before any buttons are clicked: '{countKnown ? `${nf.format(count)} selected` : 'Counting matching documents…'}'

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Selection has two modes (include/exclude); dialog accepts isFilterScoped parameter; bar shows '(all matching your filters)' only in exclude mode; canEscalate logic distinguishes page-only selection from total-match selection.

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive button with slate-100 styling, followed by '<div className="w-6 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />', then Delete button with red border/text (red-700/red-200).

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Delete button uses light red styling (bg-red-50, text-red-700), not solid red; Archive button appears first; dialog focuses inputRef, not delete button.

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Closing section states: 'Two things this component assumes and does not enforce...the server re-authorizes every document the filter resolves to. A filter-scoped delete is the single easiest place to leak a permission check.'

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Ends with 'What this makes impossible' section: listing Rung 1 impossibilities (unknown blast radius, stale selection, no hard-delete), Rung 1 reflexive impossibilities (typing requirement), and 'Left possible on purpose' section.
